summary: Full backend + frontend testing of PropConsult CRM. 53/53 pytest API tests pass covering auth (phone+OTP demo), properties CRUD + photos (upload, serve with token auth, delete), customers many-to-many, follow-ups, deals pipeline (ACTIVE_STAGES excludes Closed Won/Lost), sharing between two consultants (notifications, accept copy, is_shared flag, duplicate guard), authorization isolation (B cannot read/modify A's data), notifications read/read-all, soft-delete + bin restore + permanent delete, dashboard summary and pipeline. Frontend flows verified end-to-end: login + OTP (demo code toast), onboarding slides, dashboard KPI cards wired to live DB values, 4-step Property Wizard (Category -> Details -> Amenities -> Photos & Review -> Save), property detail page, customer create updates Active Customers KPI, share dialog creates share and green shared tick appears, recipient receives notification. No critical issues found.

issues: Minor: KPI cards show large empty right-side area on wide screens; could use a chart or recent activity to fill it

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 823 lines — recommend splitting routers (auth, properties, customers, deals, followups, sharing, bin) into modules for maintainability

GET /api/files/{path} does not enforce ownership of the storage path — any authenticated user with a valid JWT can fetch any path they can guess. Consider namespacing by owner_id and validating prefix.

accept_share deep-copies the property doc including photos array (same storage_paths referenced by two owners). If sender deletes original photo file in storage, recipient's copy breaks. Consider duplicating storage objects or snapshotting.
delete_customer / remove_customer_prop (/customers/{cid}/properties/{pid}) does not validate owner of customer — any auth user could soft-delete a link if they know both IDs. Add owner_id check.
No pagination enforcement on /notifications (hardcoded limit=100). OK for MVP.
DELETE /properties/{pid} returns 403 for non-owner but same 403 for not-found; may want 404 for missing to avoid info leak symmetric with 403.
Startup event uses deprecated @app.on_event (FastAPI); migrate to lifespan context in future.
JWT secret is in .env (good) but tokens have 30-day expiry with no refresh/revocation flow.
test_credentials: Phone+OTP demo. Unique phones generated per test run (prefix 77/88/99). Demo OTP returned in /api/auth/send-otp response as `demo_otp`.
seed_data_creation: None persistent; tests create their own data per run with TEST_ prefix on names.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope. Session-scoped fixtures (session_a, session_b) hold stateful attributes that are shared across classes in the same module. Run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -n 0` for sequential execution or ensure all classes are in a single file so loadscope keeps them on one worker (same module -> same worker). All tests pass sequentially (-n 0). Known cosmetic: SharedProperties frontend route is `/shared` not `/shared-properties` (API path).
